title: Photonium - Abyss & Void
description: A grindy and lategame/tech mod, adding a 2 new dimensions and ores as the base of the mod, this mod is intended to be paired with other grindy mods to accelerate the process of getting certain items. -- Early release, expect Bugs
body: Photonium, Abyss & void is a project focusing on bringing creative stuff to survival mode without breaking the fun of the game. It is a very grindy mod that adds 2 new dimensions, a new ore and many funcionality blocks. This mod is intended to be paired with other grindy late game mods as to facilitate obtaining many items.
